Markets.summary: The Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0 will explore how artificial intelligence is transforming portfolio management across research, execution, risk, and monitoring. Industry experts will discuss which investment processes can be automated and which still require human judgement.

Markets.title: Titan Company, Sky Gold, other shares fall up to 6% on PM Modi’s second appeal to avoid gold
Markets.summary: Shares of Titan Company and Sky Gold dropped up to 6% following Prime Minister Narendra Modi's appeal to citizens to avoid non-essential gold purchases. The statement aims to conserve foreign exchange by discouraging gold buying, repeating a similar request made in May.

Markets.title: Amazon stock under pressure after FTC alleges $20 billion Ad overcharges
Markets.summary: Amazon shares fell after the FTC and 22 states sued the company for allegedly manipulating advertising auctions and overcharging advertisers by $20 billion. The lawsuit threatens Amazon's high-margin advertising business, raising concerns about potential penalties and future profitability.

Markets.title: Global Market: China equities muted as Hong Kong stocks slide amid global risks
Markets.summary: Chinese equities remained mostly flat on Tuesday as gains in defensive sectors like banking and consumer staples offset tech stock losses. Meanwhile, Hong Kong stocks faced heavier downward pressure amid broader global risks.

Markets.title: Battle of metals: Gold or silver? What should investors choose as Warsh stokes rate hike fears?
Markets.summary: Renewed US rate hike fears following Fed Chief Kevin Warsh's remarks have clouded the near-term outlook for gold and silver despite their recent sharp rallies. While gold is preferred for its stability and safe-haven demand, silver offers higher upside potential alongside greater volatility and correction risks.

Markets.title: Broadcom faces high-stakes earnings test as AI expectations soar
Markets.summary: Broadcom faces high expectations for its upcoming earnings report following Nvidia's strong results. Investors will closely monitor its AI revenue target, custom-chip demand, and networking sales amid growing stock market volatility.

Geo-Political.title: 'I've never been to Afghanistan': Six million deportees forced to start over under the Taliban
Geo-Political.summary: Pakistan and Iran have deported one million people to Afghanistan since January. Many of these returnees have never lived in the country and now face severe difficulties rebuilding their lives under Taliban rule.

Geo-Political.summary: The death toll in Nepal is approaching 1,000 as rescuers search for workers trapped in mud-filled tunnels and thousands remain missing. Meanwhile, Chinese state media reports that the official fatality count in Tibet has reached 16.

Geo-Political.summary: Zambian President Hakainde Hichilema will be sworn in for his second term following his election victory. Meanwhile, his main political rival remains in detention facing treason charges.

Data & Insights.summary: India's manufacturing activity grew at its slowest pace in nearly five years during August due to cooling demand and reduced output. This slowdown led to a mild reduction in factory jobs despite a decrease in cost pressures.

Data & Insights.summary: Major global news highlights India hosting the Brics summit, diverging inflation rates, and Tim Cook's departure from Apple. Additional key stories cover rising youth unemployment in South Asia and the uneven impact of artificial intelligence on jobs.

Data & Insights.summary: India's Q1 real and nominal GDP figures exceeded expectations, showcasing strong economic growth despite global geopolitical tensions and oil shocks. Prime Minister Narendra Modi praised this performance as a herculean feat amid widespread global economic uncertainty.

Data & Insights.title: Behind blackouts: how dry skies and farm pumps fuelled a searing power shortage
Data & Insights.summary: A weak monsoon caused a power deficit exceeding 10 million units as farmers relied heavily on irrigation pumps. Simultaneously, households cranked up air-conditioners, fueling a severe power shortage.

Data & Insights.title: AI cyber risk is biggest immediate threat to global financial system, warns Bank of England chief
Data & Insights.summary: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey warns that rapidly advancing artificial intelligence poses the greatest immediate cyber threat to the global financial system. He stated that AI could help attackers quickly identify and exploit vulnerabilities across financial institutions and critical systems.

Data & Insights.title: Finance ministry flags global bond yield, inflation risks for India
Data & Insights.summary: The finance ministry warned that global bond yields and inflation pose risks to India's economy amid external headwinds. Despite these challenges, domestic economic momentum remained strong with stable external conditions in August.

India.title: Noida Rape Case: Bus Had 12 Challans Since April, 9 Issued In July Alone
India.summary: A bus involved in a Noida rape case accumulated 12 traffic challans since April. Speeding was the primary offense, with nine of these challans issued in July alone.

India.title: Big Port, Green Energy Projects Change Economics Around Them: Gautam Adani
India.summary: Gautam Adani noted that large ports and green energy projects can transform the economic landscape of previously undeveloped regions. He cited Mundra in Gujarat, which evolved from a barren marshy coastline three decades ago into India's largest port.

India.title: Noida Authority Approves Rs 85 Crore Flyover To Ease Expressway Traffic Between Sectors 148, 150
India.summary: The Noida Authority has approved an Rs 85 crore flyover project between sectors 148 and 150. The new infrastructure aims to reduce traffic congestion along the Noida-Greater Noida Expressway.

India.title: 47-Year-Old Woman Runs Marathon Barefoot In Saree To Pay Daughter's Fees
India.summary: A 47-year-old woman from Maharashtra won a marathon while running barefoot in a saree. She plans to use the Rs 3,000 prize money to pay her daughter's education fees.

India.title: Heavy Rain Disrupts Life In Guwahati, Waterlogging In Many Areas

India.title: Know Your World: Which Is India's 45th UNESCO World Heritage Site? A Quick GK Guide
India.summary: India ranks sixth globally and second in the Asia-Pacific region for its total number of World Heritage sites. The country currently has 45 sites included on the UNESCO World Heritage list.
